description: A library of reusable single-file HTML slide-deck templates. Each template is one self-contained .html file: no build step, no dependencies, works from file:// and offline.
name: html-presentation-templates

templates.description: Warm paper background, Didone serif display titles with a sturdier Georgia for body headings, gold accents and ornaments. Built for facilitators: labeled activity tags, timed section dividers, a live lesson-timeline footer, offline video embeds, and an on-the-fly font-size control for room readability.
templates.name: Elegant Paper

templates.description: Apple-inspired general presentation template with Liquid Glass: SF type stack, giant tight headlines, Apple blue, pill buttons, frosted refractive glass cards floating over solid color — zero gradients. Solid-black statement and closing slides, agenda, quote, stats, two-column with offline video slot, spec table, and the A−/100%/A+ font control. No lesson timeline: built as a general Canva substitute.
templates.name: Keynote
Atelier

No gradients, no timeline.

No gradients, no timeline.
